QuestInfo.name: Cleaned Out
QuestInfo.0: Lolo is having trouble finding the scroll. While he's searching, why don't you do him a favor?
QuestInfo.1: The Royal Fairies at Chimney Tree Top stole the library's cleaning tools. Bring back #b3 of Lolo's Cleaning Tools#k so he can keep the library squeaky clean.
QuestInfo.2: You found Lolo's cleaning tools. Lolo probably found the scroll by now.

0.0: It's nothing tough. I just need some cleaning tools I lost a while ago.\r\n#L0##bI shall take on your quest. Where did you lose them?#l\n#k
0.1: Stolen is more like it. I think those #bRoyal Fairies#k at #bChimney Tree#k nabbed 'em while I was on break! Can you get them back for me?

yes.0: I'll find that scroll. Just get me my cleaning tools back.

no.0: Dang. If I don't finish cleaning before Grendel gets back, he'll light my guts on fire.

1.0: You got 'em? The tools, I mean?\r\n#L0##bI have retrieved your tools and dispatched the villains who stole them.#l\n#k
1.1: Good, I thought those Fairies could use a good dispatching!

yes.0: Anyway, I got what you were looking for. Just give me a sec.

item.0: Please get my tools back from the #bRoyal Fairies#k. Pretty please.
